hunks.sol: Through the spray flying in every direction, I saw a woman staring at me with wide eyes. Her voice trembled.

hunks.baseline: A trembling voice soon pierced my ears.
I muttered inwardly, just like the young, immature boy in the dream that still felt so vivid.
hunks.sol: I muttered inwardly, like the young boy in the dream that still felt so vivid.

hunks.baseline: *I don’t know. I just woke up.*
hunks.sol: *Dunno. I just woke up.*
